head_commit.message:
feat(resources): resolve declared character audio and cross-pack forms

Use static source declarations and exact global character ownership to resolve
23,393 declared audio aliases without exposing shared skill pools. Preserve the
12,359 original resource rows and payloads; show each character's actual declared
voices and keep playback failures isolated by path.

Validated on main: resource tests 11/11, frontend 167/167, source sync and both
verify modes, 121 complete audio decodes, 14 controls playbacks, 214 real HTTP
identity checks, and nine failure/recovery cases. Final preflight 21/21 and the
independent integration review passed; historical cleanup failure and known five
Chrome codec failures remain recorded. Rules330/archive105/ABI758/WS6 unchanged.

Register the separately accepted da7e GitHub run41082599800 (10/10 successful
jobs) with raw evidence and independent review. Private C331, NC10, and five-file
codec compatibility implementations are not part of this runtime increment.
